non_claim: blank isolated-arm response template; not a completed response, not assignment disclosure, not custody evidence, and not a score sheet
instructions: Run the bundled init helper, fill only the one arm answer row and matching total cost, then run finalize with explicit clean-preanswer attestation before any post-freeze material opens.

responder_stage.bundle_hash_recording_rule: The bundled init/finalize helper computes SHA256 of the original responder ZIP handed to the responder and the bundled responder packet; expected bundle digest, custody kit, scorer kit, score sheet, manifest, and old submission kit remain unavailable before response finalization.
responder_stage.operator_cost_rule: Set one positive finite arm cost and the same positive finite run total; finalization rejects disagreement beyond 0.05 minutes.

post_response_scoring_boundary.manual_metric_scores_location: separate score sheet, not this response file
post_response_scoring_boundary.chronology: response helper init -> responder fills answers/costs -> response helper finalizes and freezes -> custody helper opens and freezes record -> score-sheet helper initializes after scorer-kit open -> score-sheet helper finalizes -> scorer validates exact triplet

custody_boundary: The response must first pass the responder-bundle finalizer. A distinct custodian then opens only the postfreeze custody kit, reruns the same response contract against the exact response bytes, binds them, and freezes the custody record. Only after that freeze may scorer/manifest/score-sheet material open.
self_hash_boundary: The expected responder_bundle_sha256 is intentionally not embedded in responder-visible files. The responder records the observed bundle digest; scorer/custody material verify it after response freeze.
preanswer_material_boundary: Only the responder bundle itself is valid pre-response material. Custody kit, scorer kit, score sheet, handoff manifest, expected digest, full archive, old submission kit, and prior conversation are post-freeze or forbidden for a clean run.
evidence_scope_boundary: This artifact can support only its single opaque arm. Cross-arm interpretation occurs after all responses freeze.
timestamp_trust_boundary: Helper-captured local process clocks reduce manual timestamp transcription and backfill, but are not a trusted timestamp service, hardware clock attestation, or independent proof of wall-clock truth.
